what: At the right end of the pill button sits a squashed blob the size of the icon circle (63% 37% 42% 58% / 32% 68% 28% 72%). When a hand hovers and stays for 120ms, over .8s it first rounds into a circle (up to the 40% mark with cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1)) and then spreads into a pill filling the whole button (cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)). On release it shrinks to a circle in .6s (60%) and returns to the blob. With look: circle, the round button itself is the blob, so it rounds in .45s and returns in .35s, and it is pressed into a round shape for 300ms the moment it is clicked

options.delay: Hold time after hover before starting (ms), default 120
options.data-fx-part=\"dot\": Icon circle at the right end — droplet width is measured by this circle’s width (button height if none)
options.data-fx-part=\"blob\": If you place a droplet directly, it is used (otherwise the part creates one)
options.--fx-blob-shape: Droplet-shaped border-radius — giving each number a different one makes a different blob per icon (original table 01~08)

use: Request a free consultation→
note: The part does not change text color — if the text must become a color on the accent after the droplet fills, apply it to .is-blob-hover in the consuming css
